messages:
Meera: Quick heads-up — planning a narrow canary for runtime v3.5 in us-east-1 tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Target traffic: 1% split across model-variants. Need preflight signoffs and smoke owners. Key asks: deploy owner, smoke test owner, rollback runbook ready, eval set green, circuit-breakers configured.

Jamal: I can own the deploy window. I'll be on-call at 08:45 UTC and will kick off the rollout.

Sara: I’ll own smoke tests (generation correctness + latency + tail p99). I have a 30-example eval set and the quick harness ready.

Alyssa: Docs & feature-flagging covered. Feature flag for canary is pinned to team/redwood-inference/canary. I’ll monitor cost & token-rate dashboards.

Ryan: Rollback runbook is ready. Quick steps below — tested on staging:
```
# revert traffic back to v3.4
redwood route set --service runtime --region us-east-1 --to v3.4 --weight 100
# scale down v3.5 pods
kubectl -n runtime scale deployment runtime-v3-5 --replicas=0
# notify downstream services
./notify_ops.sh --subject "v3.5 rollback initiated"
```
I’ve set circuit breaker thresholds: error-rate 2%, latency p95 800ms. If triggered, deploy-bot will auto-fail traffic.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: service=runtime, region=us-east-1, version=v3.5, start=2026-04-12T09:00:00Z, split=1%

Meera: Checklist (please ack):
- [ ] Deploy owner assigned (Jamal)
- [ ] Smoke owner assigned (Sara)
- [ ] Eval set passing (Sara/Alyssa)
- [ ] Circuit breakers configured (Ryan)
- [ ] Rollback runbook verified (Ryan)
- [ ] Feature flags pinned (Alyssa)
- [ ] Cost guardrails enabled (Alyssa)
- [ ] Post-deploy quick smoke (10m)

Jamal: +1 for all items. I’ll ping at T-15 and T+10.

Sara: Eval set ran on staging — all green except one tokenization diff (low impact). I’ll rerun with the trimmed prompts at T-30.

Alyssa: Cost guardrails live, alerts on #billing and #eng-sre. I’ll watch token-per-request drift.

Meera: Great. If nobody objects, proceed with schedule. Please add quick notes here when you start/finish so we have a trace. :eyes: :shipit:

Ryan: I’ll standby for a rollback. If p95 > 900ms or error-rate > 2% after 5 minutes, initiate revert.

Jamal: Noted. I’ll post T-15 now and update when canary is live.

Meera: Thanks all — keeping this narrow & observable to reduce blast radius.
